description: Source code implementing resolve undo functionality for a version control system, including functions for recording, reading, writing, clearing, and unmerging resolve undo data within an index state.

methods.name: record_resolve_undo
methods.description: Records resolve undo information for a cache entry in the index state.

methods.name: resolve_undo_write
methods.description: Serializes resolve undo information into a string buffer.

methods.name: resolve_undo_read
methods.description: Deserializes resolve undo information from a data buffer into a string list.

methods.name: resolve_undo_clear_index
methods.description: Clears resolve undo data from the index state.

methods.name: unmerge_index_entry
methods.description: Reverts a merged index entry to an unmerged state based on resolve undo info.

methods.name: unmerge_index
methods.description: Unmerges index entries matching a pathspec using resolve undo data.
